The transit subsidy rollforward failed due to incorrect cell content in the 'Bus Program #4310' sheet of the output workbook.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in test_output.py::test_legacy_node_checks while executing test_outputs.js. Although the workbook was created with correct sheet names and order, it failed the specific check: 'FAIL: Bus Program #4310!A1 must be MetroLink Transit Authority'. Ensure the data mapping for the MetroLink Transit Authority program is correctly routed to cell A1 of the specified sheet.
